ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the $20 billion Medicaid fraud investigation in Minnesota and follow the money to determine where the funds were allocated and who was involved.
questions: Where did the $20 billion in Medicaid funds go?
Who was involved in the fraud scheme?
searches: Medicaid programs at high risk for fraud
ideas.insight: This investigation could uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and potentially lead to the recovery of millions of dollars in misallocated funds.
